description: Form 3 / 4 / 5 / 144 line items for a US public company. Returns each transaction (or initial holding / proposed sale) with the insider's name, role, transaction code, share count, price, and notional.  Filters by lookback window, transaction code (P=purchase, S=sale, A=grant, M=option exercise, F=tax withholding, etc.), insider role, and minimum share threshold. Institutional plan only — every other plan gets ENTITLEMENT_DENIED with an upgrade link.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD).  Only returns transactions with accepted_at <= this date — eliminates look-ahead bias.  When set, lookback_days is ignored.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Default 100, max 500.

lineage_detail.description: Per-row provenance envelope. 'compact' (default) returns source_filing + source_url. 'full' adds accepted_at. 'off' omits lineage.

lookback_days.description: How many days back from today to scan transactions for. Ignored when as_of_date is set.

min_shares.description: Minimum |shares| per transaction. Omit for no floor.

roles_in.description: Insider roles to keep. Omit to include any role.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B — or a CIK (SEC identifier), e.g. '0000320193'.

transaction_codes.description: SEC transaction codes to keep (uppercase, single-letter):  P=purchase, S=sale, A=grant, M=option exercise, F=tax withholding, G=gift, J=other.  Unknown codes are rejected.  Omit to include all codes.

name: get_insider_transactions

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

note.description: Present when no transaction matched: the company was found, and this says which window and filters were searched.

metrics_display.description: This row's shares, price and values rendered for prose ('1.28M shares', '$249.17', '$318.92M'). QUOTE THESE VERBATIM instead of the raw numbers.

title: Insider Transactions
